text:
Olive R (Finance): Partner CloudRoute opened a ticket claiming we underpaid them on the May Azure Marketplace cycle. They say some meters ingested late and were excluded from the settled invoice. They want a supplemental payout for $23,710. Can billing ops validate?

Liam B (Billing Ops): Need their sample meter IDs + our raw ingestion timestamps. @BillingBot pull ingestion log for partner_id CR-301 for 2026-05-01..2026-05-31.

BillingBot: Querying logs... returned 3 matches where ingestion_time > settlement_cutoff (2026-05-25T00:00:00Z): meter 88421 (ingested 2026-05-26T03:12Z), meter 88422 (ingested 2026-05-26T03:14Z), meter 88423 (ingested 2026-05-26T03:20Z).

Tom V (Sales): Partner sent CSV showing those meters billed on their side and included in their internal payout calc. Snippet:
```
meter_id,sku,usage,charge
88421,sku-emb-large,250000,11250.00
88422,sku-gen,150000,7500.00
88423,sku-pro,60000,447.00
```
Partner total claim = $23,197.00 (they included small tax rounding up to $23,710).

Jin H (EngOps): Looks like our ingestion pipeline lagged due to a transient blobstore throttle on 2026-05-26. The late files arrived after the settlement snapshot. We can re-run a supplemental settlement but need finance approval for out-of-cycle payout. Also will add a monitoring alert to avoid recurrence.

Olive R (Finance): For out-of-cycle payout we need sales confirmation, legal waiver not required for underpayment, and GL direction. Propose: issue supplemental payout $23,197 gross, memo AZ-MP-2026-05-SUPP, GL code 4209-REV-ADJ. Tom confirm partner bank details and acceptance to avoid duplicate.

Tom V (Sales): Partner confirmed bank details and requests wire. They accept the supplemental settlement and will send an email acknowledgement.

Liam B (Billing Ops): I recommend we pay via AP as a one-time supplemental payout and tag ledger: Debit Revenue Adj 4209-REV-ADJ / Credit Cash/Bank 1001. Will also include memo referencing original invoice AZ-MP-2026-05-22. Proceed after finance ok.

Olive R (Finance): Approved. Release payment instruction to treasury. Please include a short note in partner record and schedule a post-mortem with EngOps to add an ingestion cutoff alert.

BillingBot: Noted. Scheduling ingestion-lag alert addition. Will flag partner record as settled after payout processed.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Payment initiated 2026-05-30T14:05:00Z via wire. Posted journal entry and updated payout history. Memo AZ-MP-2026-05-SUPP applied.

Tom V (Sales): Partner confirmed receipt at 2026-06-01T09:30:00Z. Thanks team. Closing loop.
